message.content: {"basis": "The Product Rating Share dashboard displays the following labeled rating shares for each category: Quality (14%), Price (49%), Design (30%), Support (33%), Delivery (29%), and Other (34%). The task and policy table require selecting the category with the highest current labeled rating share. The 'Price' category has the highest value at 49%. Therefore, the correct option to select is 'Select Price'." , "option_label": "Select Price"}
